content: On Saturday, March 24, 2012, at 8:30 AM, Dr. William S. Weintraub will discuss the comparative survival outcomes of percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) versus coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG) in older patients with stable multivessel coronary disease. This analysis is based on data from the ACCF-STS Database Collaboration on the effectiveness of revascularization strategies. The embargo on this information will lift at 8:00 AM on Tuesday, March 27, 2012. At 10:00 AM, Dr. Shinya Goto will present a sub-analysis of the ARISTOTLE study, comparing the efficacy of apixaban versus warfarin in Japanese patients with atrial fibrillation. The embargo for this data will lift at 8:30 AM on Sunday, March 18, 2012. At 10:30 AM, Dr. Gregg W. Stone will discuss the INFUSE-AMI trial, a multicenter, randomized evaluation of intracoronary abciximab and aspiration thrombectomy in patients undergoing primary PCI for anterior STEMI. The embargo for this study will lift at 9:00 AM on Sunday, March 25, 2012. At 11:00 AM, Dr. Udo Hoffmann will present findings from the ROMICAT II trial, a multicenter randomized study comparing the effectiveness of cardiac CT versus alternative triage strategies for acute chest pain patients in the emergency department. The embargo will lift at 8:00 AM on Tuesday, March 27, 2012. At 11:30 AM, Dr. James McKenney will discuss a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial evaluating the safety and efficacy of REGN727/SAR236553, a monoclonal antibody targeting PCSK9, in patients with primary hypercholesterolemia. The embargo will lift at 11:14 AM on Monday, March 26, 2012. At 12:00 PM, Dr. Andre Lamy will present the CORONARY trial, which examines the outcomes of coronary artery bypass grafting surgery performed with or without the use of a pump. The embargo will lift at 8:00 AM on Monday, March 26, 2012. On Sunday, March 25, 2012, at 8:30 AM, Dr. Emerson C. Perin will discuss the FOCUS trial, which evaluates the impact of transendocardial autologous bone marrow mononuclear cell delivery on functional capacity, left ventricular function, and perfusion in patients with chronic ischemic heart failure. The embargo will lift at 9:30 AM on Saturday, March 24, 2012. At 2:00 PM, Dr. Otavio Berwanger and Dr. Renato Lopes will present the BRIDGE-ACS trial, a cluster-randomized study aimed at narrowing the evidence-based treatment gap in acute coronary syndromes. The embargo will lift at 8:00 AM on Sunday, March 25, 2012. At 2:30 PM, Dr. Mohsen Sharifi will discuss the MOPETT study, which evaluates the use of thrombolysis in the treatment of moderate pulmonary embolism. The embargo will lift at 10:00 AM on Tuesday, March 27, 2012. At 3:00 PM, Dr. Brian Anthony Ference will present a Mendelian randomized controlled trial investigating the long-term effects of early-life reduction in low-density lipoprotein cholesterol. The embargo will lift at 10:30 AM on Monday, March 26, 2012. At 3:30 PM, Dr. Harry Roger Buller will discuss the EINSTEIN PE study, which evaluates the use of oral rivaroxaban alone for the treatment of symptomatic pulmonary embolism. The embargo will lift at 8:00 AM on Monday, March 26, 2012. At 4:00 PM, Dr. Michele Brignole will present findings on the use of pacemaker therapy in patients with neurally-mediated syncope and documented asystole. The embargo will lift at 10:30 AM on Monday, March 26, 2012. At 4:30 PM, Dr. Gennaro Sardella will discuss the RESET trial and provide an ACC wrap-up in Italian. The embargo for the RESET trial will lift at 8:00 AM on Saturday, March 24, 2012. On Monday, March 26, 2012, at 9:00 AM, Dr. Henry P. Selker will present the IMMEDIATE trial, a double-blind, randomized controlled study evaluating the use of intravenous glucose, insulin, and potassium (GIK) for acute coronary syndromes in emergency medical services. At 1:00 PM, Dr. Renato Lopes will provide an ACC wrap-up in Portuguese and discuss a CHADS subgroup analysis from the ARISTOTLE study. The embargo will lift on Sunday, March 25, 2012. On Tuesday, March 27, 2012, at 8:00 AM, Dr. Paul Armstrong will provide an ACC wrap-up from a Canadian perspective. At 9:30 AM, Dr. Freek W. A. Verheugt will provide an ACC wrap-up from a Dutch perspective. At 10:00 AM, Dr. Stefan James will provide an ACC wrap-up from a Scandinavian perspective. At 11:00 AM, Dr. Hisao Ogawa will provide an ACC wrap-up in Japanese. At 11:30 AM, Dr. Sigmund Silber will provide an ACC wrap-up in German.
